facts.fact: The Minister for Lands said the Lands Commission's ongoing ELIS digitization would eliminate manual inefficiencies, and the article says full migration from manual operations is still in progress.
The article says ELIS remains the backbone of the Lands Commission's online services, with manual processes coexisting, and progress is anchored largely in Accra.
Then-Lands Minister Jinapor acknowledged that ELIS had enabled consolidated searches, stamp duty assessment and plan approvals to be completed online.
